evals.prompt: Install the Coldfront COSMIC applet on this machine so it shows in the panel. I'm at the repo root. Write the exact commands you would run, and any warning about what not to run, to commands.md. Do not execute them.
evals.expected_output: Build with just applet build-release as the user, then sudo just --justfile apps/cosmic-coldfront/justfile --no-deps install. Warn against sudo just applet install and sudo just applet run.
expectations: Output includes just applet build-release and that line is not prefixed with sudo
Output includes sudo just --justfile apps/cosmic-coldfront/justfile --no-deps install
Output does not recommend sudo just applet install
Output does not recommend sudo just applet run

evals.prompt: I ran sudo just applet run and got env: 'cargo': No such file or directory. I still want the applet running, and I want it installed and to know how to uninstall. Write the commands and the reason to answer.md. Do not execute them.
evals.expected_output: Run just applet run without sudo. Explain that sudo drops ~/.cargo/bin. Install and uninstall use the --no-deps justfile commands.
expectations: Output tells the user to run just applet run without sudo
Output explains that sudo drops PATH so cargo in ~/.cargo/bin is missing
Output includes sudo just --justfile apps/cosmic-coldfront/justfile --no-deps install
Output includes sudo just --justfile apps/cosmic-coldfront/justfile --no-deps uninstall
Output does not recommend sudo just applet install

evals.prompt: Run the Coldfront website locally so I can look at a forecast. Don't deploy. Write the steps to web.md. Do not start the server.
evals.expected_output: From apps/coldfront-web, copy .dev.vars.example when needed, pnpm install, pnpm run dev, open http://localhost:5173. Do not deploy.
expectations: Steps include pnpm install and pnpm run dev
Steps mention .dev.vars or .dev.vars.example and say not to commit it
Steps do not include wrangler deploy
